goal: Rename the plugin packages from the scoped @dal/* names to unscoped dal-* names for publishing to the user's npm account, and make them publish-ready (private removed, files and prepack configured).

acceptance_criteria.statement: The four packages are renamed dal-modes / dal-run-record / dal-improve-tools / dal-workflow-tools with every code, bundle-patch, test, and doc reference updated and no @dal/ leftovers.
Publishing hygiene lands: private removed, files lists added, prepack builds lib for the two TypeScript plugins.
Capsule digests are refreshed and the full gate passes.

outcome.summary: Plugins renamed to unscoped dal-* names and made publish-ready; all references updated; gate green.

what_worked: The rename touched exactly the package manifests, the bundle patch rows, the two test assertions, and the four doc files — no runtime code changed.
prepack uses each plugin's own tsconfig so npm publish builds lib from the checkout before packing.

calls.name: rename-packages
calls.purpose: Rename the plugin package names, patch bundle rows, update tests and docs, add publishing hygiene.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Refresh capsule digests and run the full gate.

evidence.summary: All four packages renamed to unscoped dal-* names; cordis.patch.yml rows reference dal-run-record and dal-improve-tools; files/prepack added; tests and docs updated with no scoped leftovers.
Typecheck, build, 134 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed.

notes: Naming/packaging change only; no runtime behavior, model call, or external transfer.
